body: My curiosity gets the better of me as I sense the presence of the previous tenant in the crate. I carefully approach the crate, trying not to make any noise. I notice that it's slightly different from the standard delivery crates I've seen before - it's a bit larger, and the material seems to be a mix of wood and metal. I think about the tenant's previous lifestyle and whether they were a collector of unique items.
